cards.hint: Think about what the word half means for parents
options: half of the number of original, or parent, isotopes
daughter atoms turn back into parents
cards.quote: A half-life is the length of time it takes for half of the number of original, or parent, isotopes to decay to a stable daughter isotope.
cards.stem: What amount decays during the interval defined as a half-life

middle layers are always the oldest
all layers formed at the same time
cards.quote: The law of superposition says that older rocks are on the bottom and younger rocks are on the top.
cards.stem: According to superposition, where are the oldest layers located
